core: Nucleotide deamination editing by APOBEC and ADAR
name: APOBEC and ADAR nucleic acid deamination editing
rationale: All members concern base deamination by APOBEC cytidine deaminases (antiviral restriction, C-to-U editing) or ADAR editosomes; the ADAR A-to-I editing members are what the HIV, antibody-diversification and DNA-demethylation confusables lack.

name: Chemosensory perception of taste and smell
rationale: Members cover all five taste modalities, olfactory and pheromone receptors and the acid-sensing channels used in sour taste; confusables are pain/thermal sensing, CFTR transport, K2P channels and olfactory development.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to RAS and PI3K
name: MET-centred receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to RAS and PI3K
rationale: Members are RTK adaptor cascades (SHC/SOS/IRS/PI3K/PLCG/STAT3) dominated by HGF-MET plus EPO, IGF1R, ALK and LTK; the MET members distinguish it from ERBB and cytokine-receptor confusables.

qualifier: base excision, mismatch and alkylation reversal
name: Base excision, mismatch and direct-reversal DNA repair
rationale: Members span glycosylase-initiated BER and its defects, mismatch repair and its defects, ALKBH/MGMT alkylation reversal, TET-TDG demethylation and crosslink repair; confusables instead centre on NER, translesion synthesis and antibody hypermutation.

qualifier: sulfated GAG chains and their congenital defects
name: Sulfated glycosaminoglycan biosynthesis and congenital defects
rationale: All members concern synthesis of chondroitin, dermatan, heparan and keratan sulfate chains and linkage region, or inherited enzyme defects therein; confusables involve O-mannose, O-fucose glycosylation or sulfate transporters.

name: Rhesus glycoprotein ammonium and CO2 transport
rationale: Members describe Rh/RHAG glycoproteins, their biosynthesis and defect, and the ammonium and CO2 transport they mediate; confusables are erythrocyte O2/CO2 exchange and peptide transport.

name: Cell-substrate adhesion and spreading with MET-FAK signaling
rationale: Members concern integrin/syndecan-mediated attachment, spreading and stress fibres, and the MET-PTK2/tensin members are what all adhesion and migration confusables lack.

name: Fanconi anemia crosslink repair and protein monoubiquitination cycle
rationale: Members centre on Fanconi anemia ICL repair, FANCD2/FANCI monoubiquitination and USP1 deubiquitination with checkpoint and genome-stability control; the monoubiquitination members distinguish it from recombination and telomere confusables.

name: Cytochrome P450 and leukotriene eicosanoid metabolism
rationale: Members cover leukotriene synthesis, transport and catabolism plus P450 omega-hydroxylase and epoxygenase HETE/EET production; the P450 branch distinguishes it from lipoxin and lipoxygenase confusables.

qualifier: BCL-2 family and p53 transcriptional targets
name: BCL-2-family mitochondrial apoptosis and p53 transcriptional targets
rationale: Members describe BH3-only/BAX/BAK-driven MOMP, cytochrome c and SMAC release, the apoptosome and p53-induced death genes; confusables are extrinsic/necroptotic death or generic p53 regulation terms.

name: Glucose glycolysis and gluconeogenesis including GLUT1 uptake
rationale: Members are core glucose glycolysis/gluconeogenesis and hexokinase and GLUT1 defects; confusables concern fructose, glycogen, galactose and pentose metabolism.

core: Retroviral life cycle and host restriction
name: HIV life cycle, retroelement restriction and antibody diversification
rationale: Members span HIV entry, reverse transcription and integration, host restriction and retroelement silencing, plus B-cell V(D)J, hypermutation and class switching; confusables are RNA-virus replication and ADAR editing.

name: CC chemokine production and macrophage chemotaxis
rationale: Members regulate CCL2, CCL3 and CCL5 production and macrophage chemotaxis; confusables involve neutrophil formyl-peptide/CXC chemotaxis or dendritic-cell cGAS-STING cytokines.

name: Cobalamin absorption and transport and inherited defects
rationale: Members cover intestinal uptake and plasma/cellular transport of vitamin B12 and CBLIF, TCN2, ABCD4 defects; confusables concern intracellular cobalamin metabolism and MMA disorders.

name: Neutrophil degranulation and myeloid cytotoxic killing
rationale: Members concern neutrophil degranulation and regulation of myeloid-mediated killing; confusables centre on respiratory burst or generic inflammatory and complement signaling.

name: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate family amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members cover glutamate/glutamine, aspartate/asparagine and citrulline metabolism and nitrogen utilization; aspartate-family biosynthesis distinguishes it from TCA, alanine and proline confusables.

core: Coenzyme A and NADP cofactor metabolism
name: Coenzyme A, NADP cofactor metabolism and peroxisome maintenance
rationale: Members concern CoA/pantothenate and acyl-CoA metabolism, NAD(P) synthesis and transport, and peroxisome fission/protease processing; confusables are fatty acid oxidation, TCA and amino acid catabolism.

name: Post-Golgi endosomal sorting to lysosomes and recycling
rationale: Members cover Golgi-endosome-lysosome transport, retrieval to Golgi and endosomal recycling to plasma membrane; confusables centre on COPI traffic and Golgi organization.

name: Microautophagy, chaperone-mediated autophagy and aggrephagy
rationale: Members are CMA, endosomal and nuclear microautophagy, aggrephagy, ATG8 delipidation and nutrient-triggered autophagy; confusables involve pexophagy/mitophagy or aggresome and ERAD quality control.

name: Atypical MAPK signaling and peptidyl-serine phosphorylation control
rationale: Members concern RAS-MAPK relay including ERK5 and MAPK6/MAPK4 and regulation of serine phosphorylation; confusables focus on ERK inactivation, oncogenic RAF/RAS or neurotrophin-ERK5.

core: Centrosome and microtubule organizing centre organization
qualifier: centriole duplication, spindle orientation and cilium dynamics
name: Centrosome, centriole duplication, spindle orientation and cilium dynamics
rationale: Members concern centriole duplication and cohesion, MTOC nucleation and anchoring, spindle positioning and cilium assembly/disassembly; confusables are mitotic centrosome maturation or tubulin modification.

name: K2P, KATP and calcium-activated potassium channels in hyperpolarization
rationale: Members are tandem-pore, KATP (and ABCC8/9 defects) and KCa channels and resting potential/hyperpolarization regulation; confusables involve Kir/Kv channels, sodium transport or smooth muscle.

qualifier: cancer-relevant targets: cadherins, PTEN, PD-L1, PAX3
name: Gene-specific transcriptional repression of cancer-relevant targets
rationale: Members are negative transcription/DNA-binding regulation and promoter-level control of CDH1, CDH11, PTEN, PD-L1, TGFBR3 and PAX3 targets; confusables are RUNX3, FOXO and BMP/TGF-beta programmes.

name: Glycosphingolipid biosynthesis and intermembrane transport
rationale: Members cover galactosylceramide, ganglioside and glycosphingolipid synthesis plus glycolipid and ceramide-1-phosphate transfer; confusables are GPI anchors, phospholipid transfer and lysosomal catabolism.

qualifier: processing and degradation rather than import
name: Mitochondrial protein processing and degradation
rationale: All members concern proteolytic processing and catabolism of mitochondrial proteins; confusables concern import, cristae, calcium uniporter or ER quality control.
